about: Simple-mode output of nli_label.py: one row per line, these fields, in this order. include: which lines get a row (remove, review, keep, pass, untouched, error). omit_empty: leave out empty values. evidence: none / decided (remove + review lines) / all: writes <name>.evidence.jsonl.zst with the paragraphs and scores. reason_text: label, exception key or technical reason -> word (exact keys first, then * patterns).
